title: Cooperative flame retardancy of ammonium polyphosphate and magnesium–aluminum-layered double hydroxide (LDH) in EVA blends
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17074-17084
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00909C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Meimei Yu, Shuo Qian, Yuxin Zuo, Yunya Wu, Zhi Li, Zhuo Wang, Zhiqi Liu, Pengfei Cheng
The EVA composite with 8% APP and 47% MgAl-LDH achieved UL-94 V-0, 29.3% LOI, and 52.8% higher elongation. APP formed a dense char layer, enhancing flame retardancy.
